class_coverage.policy: Official validation/test contain only the evaluable classes. Metrics on them average over those classes only. The unevaluated classes are measured only on the internal holdout, which is carved from train and may be optimistic if train contains near-duplicates.

training.selection_criterion: internal holdout macro-F1 over all 43 classes
